title: Annotatio IV §.XVII: Rome persecutes them as Bulgars/Albigenses — Armachanus narrates; Morneus digests
pass_a_gloss: Although for this very cause — that with generous breast they opposed themselves to the Papacy — the Roman Curia with all arts and forces persecuted them to extermination. The most cruel kinds of persecutions inflicted on the Waldenses under the names of Bulgars and Albigenses the most learned Armachanus narrates at greatest length from many Historians of this Age, in the said book’s last chapter, or 10, from §. 18 and 27 to the end of the chapter; Philip Morneus reduced all into a compendium, appending a summary Confession of theirs concerning the Sacred Supper,
pass_b_english: Because they opposed the Papacy with generous courage, the Roman Curia hunted them to extermination with every art and force.
Armachanus narrates the cruellest persecutions under the names Bulgars and Albigenses; Morneus digests it and appends their summary Confession on the Sacred Supper.
source_text: Quanquam hanc ipsam ob causam, quòd generoso pectore sese Papatui opposuerunt, Curia Romana omnibus artibus viribusque eos in exterminium persecuta sit. Persecutionum genera crudelissima, Waldensibus, sub nominibus Bulgarorum & Albigensium, illata, ex multis hujus Seculi Historicis, prolixissimè enarrat doctissimus Armachanus, libro dicto cap. postremo, seu 10, à §. 18. & 27. ad finem usque capitis; in compendium omnia redegit, Confessionem eorum de S. Cœna subnectens summariam, Philippus Morneus,
